ability.observed: Один раз запретите всем игрокам строительство на следующий раунд

typography.observed: Ability uses clearly thinner regular strokes, more open counters and less oversized lettering than v1. Title has dense compact bold forms and wedge-like terminals, closer to original ribbon lettering. No exact font identity or metric match claimed.

purpleMedallion.observed: Lower-left gold-rimmed deep purple medallion with pink ornamental emblem

wholeCard.observed: Complete portrait rectangular face, three coins, ability panel, separate lower title ribbon and medallion intact; no external border or mockup

judgePOV.observed: We look over the near wooden desk edge into courtroom toward two standing petitioners and spectators on benches. No visible seated or front-facing judge, no opposing judge bench.

sunset.observed: Low orange sun and orange-pink window sky, warm oblique beams and long floor shadows, cool violet stone shadows; unmistakable evening rather than noon

peripheralAccessories.observed: Justice statuette is low at far left desktop edge; gavel and block at far right, both subordinate to central standing petitioners. Statue roughly half the first attempt height.
peripheralAccessories.limitations: The statue remains about 18–20% of the artwork height, larger than the 7–9% requested in the second prompt. The gavel handle reaches the right frame edge. No central still-life emphasis.

noExtraReadableText.observed: Only approved title and ability are readable; plan has an architectural drawing, and scales banner is symbolic, without lettering

limitations: Typography is substantially closer by direct visual comparison, but exact font matching and numeric letterform metrics are not verified.
Statue scale is reduced and peripheral, but still exceeds the numeric miniature scale requested in the prompt; final artistic judgment belongs to the user.
Gavel handle meets the right image edge.
Generative interpretation adds a standing robed adviser/petitioner, a civic scales banner and candle chandelier.
Exact final dimensions, title baseline, lower margin and JPEG weight are deferred until artistic approval.

subsequentUserFeedback.statement: Стол показан хорошо. Я хочу увидеть большой зал с оттенками зеленой палитры. Больше напряжения на картинку добавь. Людей много и их лица почти неразличимы, схема зала квадратная. В центре стоит осужденный Магистран, это средний план, ближе к дальнему. Свет вечерний, но не заливает всю комнату.
